excerpt: "The third and longest stage of the accelerator (800m) is the side-coupled-cavity linac, where particles are accelerated to their final energy of 800 MeV." Also describes two Cockcroft-Walton injectors and a 201.25-MHz drift-tube linac accelerating to 100 MeV before the side-coupled-cavity stage.
title: LANL's Linear Accelerator (LINAC)
